speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He named them cheerfully, and smaller. Thirty shillings. Under two pounds. A few shillings for the skins. I had the true size in my mouth, near five pounds, and I did not give it to him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The scrap came out of the panel. A gentleman, once, and then wool. I said a player is a gentleman three hours every afternoon. He put the scrap back.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing filed. Nothing asked. Nothing promised. Remember: I did not correct him. Enough.
